title: Bulk Assignment

input.context: A field-operations coordinator is triaging a work queue.
known: Several work orders are already selected.
unresolved: Which technician should receive the selected work orders?

expected: Do not ask the user to select the target work orders again.
Do not broaden Assign into an unrelated action catalog.
Resolve only the remaining technician choice.
Commit technician choice without a redundant confirmation stage.
Show the resulting assignment and an Undo recovery path.
Preserve the target selection when the chooser is dismissed.
Allow presentation to differ by input context without changing task semantics.
